messages:
sam: dropping a quick Figma frame — trying a ‘rewind’ affordance on the version timeline + thinking about where the rollback CTA should live. link: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX/review jordan: looking — my first instinct: don’t make rewind the primary action on the compact timeline. users will scan left-to-right, we’ll get accidental clicks. put it inside the version detail flyout instead. :thinking: maria: accessibility note: screen readers will hit the first interactive element first. if rewind is first, blind users might get alarmed. prefer a descriptive link before the action: e.g. “View snapshot” then “Rewind to this version”. avoid ambiguous labels like just “Rollback”. liam: microcopy suggestion: confirm modal should read: “Rewind to v1.4 and route 100% traffic — this will take ~30s.” show canary state if there’s an active canary. Also we should surface a small ETA/impact bar in the modal. sam: keyboard flow question — we want an obvious tab order and a single keystroke to open version details (maybe Enter on focused card) and a shortcut for rewind (proposed: r). need to ensure focus lands in the confirm dialog and that Escape cancels. jordan: on visual hierarchy: use outline/secondary for the rewind CTA in the timeline card and reserve a solid primary on the inspector panel confirm button. add a tiny risk-meter (green/yellow/red) next to the version timestamp so people can judge at a glance. design-bot: updated component: version-card-v3 (uses role=button, tabindex=0). snippet: ```html
…
``` maria: suggested SR-friendly labels/examples: `aria-label="View snapshot for v1.4 — created Mar 2"` and `aria-describedby="v1-4-risk"` for the risk meter. also make the confirm dialog title explicit: "Confirm rewind to v1.4". liam: microcopy A/B list (for testing): - A: "Rewind to this version" / confirm "Rewind and route traffic" - B: "Restore snapshot" / confirm "Restore and route traffic" - C: "Roll back" / confirm "Rollback to this version" Which reads clearest to non-technical PMs? jordan: we should also show an undo toast after the action: "Rewind initiated — undo? (10s)" and a small timeline marker for the rollback event. :thumbsup: sam: plan: I’ll mock two variants by Friday — A) CTA in the timeline card (inline) and B) CTA in the inspector panel (focused, with confirm). I’ll include keyboard flows and SR labels. posting screenshots when ready. deploy-bot: staging preview up: https://staging.redwood-inf.dev/preview/1755550000 — includes latest timeline markup
